b: Almost 20 years ago, my mom divorced my dad for a guy she randomly met​. Guy is about 7 years younger than mom. Back then, neither my dad nor me understood why she did it, nonetheless she did. Soon after she married the guy.

It turned out the guy is a crappy husband. My dad is hardworking and tried his best to provide. New husband isn't. He spent several years unemployed, later secured some income but never enough to even be independent, let alone provide for anyone. He has basically lived off my mom all that time.

My mom is college educated and he barely has high school; they aren't on the same level intelectually and don't have much to talk about. When they do, it often ends in an argument. They share some interests like sports but it's not much.

Over the years they have more or less grown to resent each other. Mom endlessly criticizes him for leeching off her (understandably) and he gets back at her for endlessly criticizing him. ​They can barely tolerate each other by now.

But the issue is, my mom is getting old. She is 65, has several health issues and cannot maintain a household alone. She also has 3 cats and couldn't take care of them. So despite hating her husband, ​she needs him, and he needs her also, being economically dependent on her.

Every time I visit, she ends up talking about how much she resents the husband and her life in general. Sometimes breaking down in tears. She is unhappy and stressed, drowns her sorrows in wine and cigarettes every day which makes everything even worse, including her health. I feel she wants me to help her somehow, but I'm honestly clueless. I don't know what she should do. I don't know what I would do. But I don't want to watch her wither away. How can I help her?
